name: Surf
description: Perfect balance. Riding the waves requires a surfer to have the ability to concentrate in a critical moment and to keep calm. The same qualities are needed for a tanker. This paint won't give you any advantage in a battle but may help you to catch the wave of success and stay on it for a long time.
interestingFacts: This paint was added to the game on October 1st, 2020.
This paint could have been unlocked at Tier 33 of the October 2020 Challenge A.
This paint was added to containers on February 5th, 2021.

Oddly enough, this paint is actually a plain minty-green color when it's in the can. When applied to a tank, however, the additional clear-coat of metallic nanoparticles plays unexpected tricks on the eyes and gives Surf its shimmering blue-purple sheen.
